verdict.rationale: Pylon is a hosted SaaS, so headless operation here means driving it without the UI. Its documented REST API lets a programmatic consumer read and act on data, including creating issues, so scripts or pipelines can automate it, and Background Agents run work asynchronously. The evidence shows no CLI, CI integration, or pipeline tooling, and the probe found no published OpenAPI spec. missing for 10: official CLI or CI integration (e.g. GitHub Action), documented CI/headless usage guidance and service-account auth for pipelines, published OpenAPI spec, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Pylon's API can be used to programmatically access and take action on data within Pylon.
Background Agent runs asynchronous workflows so work can happen in the background.
